snippet.title: Squad - Console Announcement Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2026 Showcase
snippet.description:
Find this game and every game from Galaxies Spring on our Steam Event page - https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/45348822/view/719040453611095010

Offworld Industries' tactical shooter is built around large-scale combined-arms battles, where communication and teamwork matter more than kill counts. You coordinate infantry, vehicles and logistics with your squad to win the fight. Now coming to console platforms.
